name: generated-workspace-visual-contract
goal: Register visual cases from nested workspaces at the repository registry

evidence: A generated visual unit in a nested app workspace lacks registration at the repository registry.
Existing generator cases cover project-root components and routes only; they do not check monorepo registry ownership, test paths, scenario working directory, or build identity.

The existing generator case fails at 41822ff57b on harbor-mbp-2 because portal.component.workspace-card lacks its contract. Harness record b93a4c173fef4ff8959085d23fcd8edd1ed9d7246a67f5e45e52c2c35e0e32eb.
Commit 23d96efe42 registers nested visual cases at the repository registry and selects their workspace build.
Harness record 2248893c5eeb39b4de6e12f1d210e5639cfb81f4196246e135c179ab09d58a40 passed the unchanged case at 23d96efe42 on harbor-mbp-2 with the red profile.
